title: SanntiS 1.0: data and analyses
description:
Runbooks that reproduce the data, models and analyses behind SanntiS 1.0 (objectives 00-03: data collection, production models, MIBiG 3.1 validation, tool comparison), with the expected results each runbook is checked against.
